description: Afghanistan - Travel Time to Nearest Town is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Demographics, Transport", published or maintained by Alexandros Korkovelos (World Bank Group). Travel time to the nearest town of 50,000 people. Spatial resolution 0.014 degrees. Source: Joint Research Center EU. Coverage: Afghanistan. It has 1 file in TIFF. The portal files it under Demographics, Transport. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
